description: Sui Southern Gas Company Limited is a natural gas utility engaged in the transmission and distribution of natural gas in its franchise provinces of Sindh and Balochistan since 1954, with over 4,200 km of transmission and around 50,000 km of distribution pipelines. It purchases gas from onshore indigenous gas fields as well as RLNG re-gasification terminals and supplies some 3.5 million customers. It also operates a meter manufacturing plant assembling G-4 and G-16 domestic gas meters.

products.name: Natural gas transmission and distribution

products.name: LPG marketing and distribution - SSGC-LPG Ltd.
